target: expanded tool catalogue and experiment archive

contract.purpose: Publish a plain, agent-first evidence map for local web and iOS testing tools.
contract.canonicalPurpose: Help an agent choose, reproduce and independently verify a testing approach without repeating completed screening.
contract.audience: Coding agents and engineers evaluating local application testing tools.
contract.job: Choose a tool by evidence state, inspect the experiment, and replay it when justified.
contract.thesis: A simple table and experiment record are more useful than a visual dashboard.
contract.system: Existing paper-like field guide, restrained typography, plain tables, no client JavaScript.
contract.signature: Evidence labels distinguish benchmarked, screened, setup-blocked and researched-only tools.
contract.risk: A long catalogue can imply unsupported equivalence; every entry must expose its evidence state.

answers.product: A reusable runner and evidence map for local web and iOS testing tools.
answers.audience: Coding agents and engineers selecting application-testing tools.
answers.value: Avoid repeating completed screening and distinguish tested evidence from documentation research.
answers.mechanism: A dated catalogue links each tool to an evidence state, while the experiment page publishes results, limitations, pins and replay commands.
answers.proof: The site lists 54 tools, eight experiment groups and exact observed versions from the Vaultwealth run.
answers.nextAction: Open the tool catalogue, inspect the relevant experiment, then clone the private runner only if a replay is justified.

ownerFeedback.note: Owner rejected the proposed visual directions as over-engineered and requested a very simple, non-sloppy presentation. Preserve the existing field-guide style and add only plain tools and experiments pages.
